using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.UnitTests.Functions;

public class KernelFunctionFromPromptTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_LogsWarning_WhenTokenCountsMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new MockLogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>();
        var function = new FakeKernelFunctionFromPrompt(logger);

        // Act
        function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", metadata: new Dictionary<string, object?>(), logger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Contains("Unable to get token details from model result.", logger.Messages);
        Assert.True(logger.LogLevel == LogLevel.Warning);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_RecordsMetricsAndSkipsLogging_WhenTokenCountsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new MockLogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>();
        var function = new FakeKernelFunctionFromPrompt(logger);

        // Act
        function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", metadata: new(), logger);

        // Assert - No warning logged when tokens would be present (early return avoided)
        Assert.DoesNotContain("Unable to get token details from model result.", logger.Messages);
    }
}

internal class FakeKernelFunctionFromPrompt : KernelFunctionFromPrompt
{
    public FakeKernelFunctionFromPrompt(ILogger logger) : base("test", logger)
    {
    }

    public void CaptureUsageDetails(string modelId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? metadata, ILogger logger)
    {
        // Extract the private method logic for testability
        var usageDetails = metadata?.TryGetValue("Usage", out var usageObj) == true && usageObj is IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> usageDict
            ? new StreamingTokenUsageReport(
                input: usageDict.TryGetValue("InputTokens", out var inputObj) && inputObj is int inputCount ? inputCount : (int?)null,
                output: usageDict.TryGetValue("OutputTokens", out var outputObj) && outputObj is int outputCount ? outputCount : (int?)null)
            : null;

        if (usageDetails is null ||
            (!s_invocationTokenUsagePrompt.Enabled && !s_invocationTokenUsageCompletion.Enabled))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(modelId))
        {
            logger.LogInformation("No model ID provided to capture usage details.");
            return;
        }

        if (usageDetails is null)
        {
            logger.LogInformation("No usage details was provided.");
            return;
        }

        if (usageDetails.InputTokenCount.HasValue && usageDetails.OutputTokenCount.HasValue)
        {
            TagList tags = new()
            {
                { MeasurementFunctionTagName, this.Name },
                { MeasurementModelTagName, modelId }
            };
            s_invocationTokenUsagePrompt.Record(usageDetails.InputTokenCount.Value, in tags);
            s_invocationTokenUsageCompletion.Record(usageDetails.OutputTokenCount.Value, in tags);
        }
        else
        {
            logger.LogWarning("Unable to get token details from model result.");
        }
    }
}

internal class MockLogger<T> : ILogger<T>
{
    public List<string> Messages { get; } = new();
    public LogLevel LogLevel { get; private set; }

    public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null!;

    public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

    public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
    {
        LogLevel = logLevel;
        Messages.Add(formatter(state, exception));
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.UnitTests.Functions;

public class KernelFunctionFromPromptLoggerExtensionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_IsCalled_WhenTokenCountsMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);
        
        // Setup to verify the LogWarning extension method call
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v).Contains("Unable to get token details from model result.")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
            .Verifiable();

        // Create real KernelFunctionFromPrompt instance using public factory
        var promptConfig = new PromptTemplateConfig { Template = "test", Name = "test", Description = "test" };
        var kernelFunction = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.Create(promptConfig, loggerFactory: new LoggerFactory());

        // Use reflection to access private CaptureUsageDetails method
        var captureMethod = typeof(KernelFunctionFromPrompt)
            .GetMethod("CaptureUsageDetails", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;

        // Act - Trigger the warning path: usageDetails exists but missing both token counts
        var metadataWithPartialUsage = new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["Usage"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
            {
                // Intentionally missing InputTokens/OutputTokens to hit the LogWarning branch
            }
        };
        captureMethod.Invoke(kernelFunction, new object?[] { "gpt-4", metadataWithPartialUsage, loggerMock.Object });

        // Assert
        loggerMock.VerifyAll();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_IsNotCalled_WhenTokenCountsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

        var promptConfig = new PromptTemplateConfig { Template = "test", Name = "test", Description = "test" };
        var kernelFunction = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.Create(promptConfig, loggerFactory: new LoggerFactory());

        var captureMethod = typeof(KernelFunctionFromPrompt)
            .GetMethod("CaptureUsageDetails", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;

        // Full usage details that should skip the warning
        var metadataWithFullUsage = new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["Usage"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
            {
                ["InputTokens"] = 100,
                ["OutputTokens"] = 50
            }
        };

        // Act
        captureMethod.Invoke(kernelFunction, new object?[] { "gpt-4", metadataWithFullUsage, loggerMock.Object });

        // Assert - No warning logged
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_IsNotCalled_WhenUsageDetailsNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

        var promptConfig = new PromptTemplateConfig { Template = "test", Name = "test", Description = "test" };
        var kernelFunction = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.Create(promptConfig, loggerFactory: new LoggerFactory());

        var captureMethod = typeof(KernelFunctionFromPrompt)
            .GetMethod("CaptureUsageDetails", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;

        // Act - null metadata triggers early return before warning
        captureMethod.Invoke(kernelFunction, new object?[] { "gpt-4", null, loggerMock.Object });

        // Assert - No warning logged (early return)
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Never);
    }
}
